metadata.title: AlgebraDx Open Diagnostic Item Bank for Algebra Readiness (Grades 9-12)
metadata.description:
Forty original multiple-choice items for diagnosing algebra readiness in grades 9-12. Every wrong answer is coded to one of 64 research-documented misconceptions and paired with a teaching move and a probe question. Includes parallel 20-item forms, a teacher guide, CSV/JSON exports and a local calibration kit. No student data collected; no NAEP or TIMSS item text reproduced.

Items were drafted with AI assistance from the published misconception research and reviewed and verified by the author.
